newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed drops on poor export demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed drops on poor export demand.

text.p: Castorseed prices fell on Thursday ahead of new crop arrivals and hit by the absence of fresh export demand, dealers said.
Castorseed December delivery fell further to 1,125/1,126 rupees per quintal from 1,132/1,134.
The new crop arrivals are likely to be delayed due to heavy rains in southern India, they said.
Groundnut oil bounced back to 414/415 rupees per 10 kg from 400/402 rupees on seasonal buying. In Rajkot, spot oil climbed 20 rupees to 590/595 per 15 kg.
